domain: Invented: three fictional cloud note-taking services (Quillbase, Larkpad, Mossnote) compared for a small team. No real vendor is named or described.

support-window.question: Does the service commit to a dated end of support for the current plan?

anchors.1: a source states support for the current plan ends within 12 months
anchors.3: a source states a support commitment with no date
anchors.5: a source states a dated support commitment more than 12 months out

data-export.question: Can a team export all of its data in an open, documented format?

anchors.1: a source states no export exists
anchors.3: a source documents export in a proprietary format only
anchors.5: a source documents export of all data in an open, documented format

migration-effort.question: How much effort does leaving the service take?

anchors.1: a source states migration requires the vendor's paid professional services
anchors.3: a source states a self-serve migration path exists with stated limits
anchors.5: a source states a complete self-serve migration path with no stated limits
